notes: Merged the four old guitar-string kinds (electric, acoustic, classical, 'Other') into Guitar strings with material/gauge/coating types; 'Other guitar strings' catch-all dissolved. Old ranges kept as r except those absorbed into archetypes (Slinky, XL, XS, NYXL, Nanoweb/Polyweb/Optiweb). HRS (La Bella) moved to Bass strings. Left out: Gibson Burstbucker (no retrievable page confirmed it), Warmoth/Allparts model families and style lists (only retrieved pages describe them generically), EMG 81 introduction year, Slinky/XL introduction years, backplates and control plates as named items, Fender Noiseless and other unconfirmed versions. Brands Gibson, Fender, Gretsch, Epiphone, Kahler, Schaller, Gotoh recorded from knowledge (founding years only where sure).
